decisions.reason: As an incremental, core-range burner improvement, management is likely to keep it because its engineering effort supports the firm's efficiency promise and any weak traction can still be rationalized as temporary despite limited public commitment.
Because this plaque heater was given its own page and fits the firm's established heating portfolio closely, management has visible commitment and good reason to persist rather than withdraw quickly.
This radiant heater is close to the firm's existing offer, so sunk development and sales effort favor continuation even though the public commitment appears relatively modest.
A multi-model tube-heater line represents the strongest investment and strategic embedding in the core business, which makes escalation of commitment especially likely and withdrawal unlikely.
This standard plaque heater was publicly presented on its own page and remains central to the firm's mainstream offer, so management is inclined to keep it and justify results over a longer horizon.

Although this tube heater seems less visibly promoted and may overlap with other models, it still belongs to the core infrared range, so management would more likely retain it than cut it immediately.
